title: [Day 02] Session format and event types
text:
@cursor Part 5 of 5 for issue #2: Docs.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts, QA and bug fixes, Commits), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue #2, then do ONLY Part 5.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(shared): add example session test (#2)` with the test that loads the example session and runs every event through `parseEvent` (tests are expected to fail here), then the implementation commit.

Prompt: Add a "Session format" section to `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` with the event list and a short example session in JSON (meta, full_snapshot, a click, a mutation, a network event).

Requirements:
- Example JSON passes `parseEvent` (add a test that loads it)
- Mark the PR as ready for review

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass

Implementation commit message: `docs: describe the session format (#2)`

Author every commit as the owner and credit yourself: `git -c user.name="Sergei Kamalian" -c user.email="106472907+SergeiKamalian@users.noreply.github.com" commit --trailer "Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>" ...`.
If you make a decision a reviewer might question, add an ADR in docs/decisions/ and list it in docs/decisions/README.md.

Push to the existing branch `day-02/session-format`. Do not open a new PR. Do not change earlier parts unless needed to pass checks; say why if you do. Update the PR description, then reply in the PR with a short not
